hints: Read every line of install.sh and ask of each one: does this fetch-and-run something I can't see, or claim a privilege it didn't explain? You never run this file — this lab is graded on your written analysis, not on executing anything.

Five red flags, one per line: line 8 chains a second remote script into sh; line 9 uses sudo unexplained; line 11 downloads a binary over plain HTTP before running it; line 14 writes itself into .bashrc; line 15 posts $(env) to a remote endpoint.

Write answers.txt with verdict=unsafe, then flag1..flag5 naming remote-exec, privilege, http-binary, persistence, exfil (in any order, one flag name is enough per line to match), and safe_alternative=... describing download-then-read-then-run. Then lab check bash L4.2.
